name: Nami
title: the Tidecaller

Q.name: Aqua Prison
Q.description: Nami hurls a bubble, Stunning for 1.5 seconds and dealing 90/145/200/255/310 + 0.5×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

W.name: Ebb and Flow
W.description: Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to 3 targets.Restores 55/80/105/130/155 + 0.4×AP Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion. Deals 60/95/130/165/200 + 0.5×AP magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion. The damage and healing value is modified by (-20 + 0.15×AP) × 0.01 each bounce.
W.summary: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

E.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
E.description: Nami empowers an allied champion's next 3 Attacks and Abilities for 6 seconds, causing them to Slow their targets by (15/20/25/30/35 + 0.05×AP) × 0.01 for 1s and deal an additional 20/35/50/65/80 + 0.2×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

R.name: Tidal Wave
R.description: Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by 70%, and dealing 150/250/350 + 0.6×AP magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to 4 seconds. Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
R.summary: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

Passive.name: Surging Tides
Passive.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.
Passive.summary: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Enchanter support who trades with W bounces and empowers her carry's attacks with E. Q bubble picks and R wave engages or peels.
strengths: Q bubble is a long stun that sets up kills
W heals her ally and damages an enemy in one cast
E makes her carry's next 3 hits slow and deal bonus damage
R wave knocks up a whole line for engage or disengage
weaknesses: Q is slow and easy to sidestep
Damage depends on a nearby ally for E and W bounces
Weak to hard engage once Q is down

curve.items: medium – enchanter items (Moonstone/Ardent) boost team, not her

profile.curveNote: Buff carry with E for trades.
profile.waveClear: low – no AoE farm tool besides R
profile.sustain: medium – W heals ally (and herself on bounce)
profile.mobility: low – passive move speed on allies only

Q.notes: Ground-targeted bubble with delay: suspends then stuns 1.5 s. Move sideways on cast.

W.notes: Bounces ally→enemy→ally, up to 3 targets. Stand away from your allies to avoid the bounce.

E.notes: Ally's next 3 attacks/abilities slow and deal bonus damage. Back off when her carry glows.

R.notes: Slow wave; knock-up and slow. Slow lasts longer the farther it traveled.

Passive.notes: Allies hit by her abilities gain move speed.

profile.windowAgainst: Q on cooldown: no pick threat; all-in her or her carry.
checks: Q tagged airborne + stun (bubble suspends target)
